page.overview:
What is Bo-rifle?

The bo-rifle was a type of weapon that uniquely combined the functions of an electrostaff and a blaster rifle, intended for exclusive use by the Honor Guard of Lasan. It was considered a great insult if it was used by anyone else. The only known exception to this was if the individual in question had defeated a guardsmen and been presented with their weapon, in accordance with the Boosahn Keeraw, the warrior way of the Lasat species.

It consisted of a staff that could be collapsed to a length roughly equivalent to a standard blaster rifle. When extended, the weapon's tip(s) were electrified, up to 11,000 volts, either purple or yellow in color and were the primary contact points of the weapon during melee combat. The number of tips on the weapon depended on the model (AB-75 and J-19 had two, the CJ-9 had one). The weapon functioned as a quarterstaff when used in melee combat. When retracted or folded, the weapon functioned as a blaster rifle.

The bo-rifle was the exclusive weapon of the Lasan High Honor Guard. It was an insult to Lasat culture for anyone else to wield the weapon Following the devastation of Lasan, bo-rifles were rarely seen in the galaxy, although some CJ-9 bo-rifles would later fall into the hands of both the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Galactic Empire by the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Agent Alexsandr Kallus, a member of the Galactic Empire's Imperial Security Bureau who took part in the siege of Lasan, acquired his J-19 bo-rifle via the Boosahn Keeraw. During the battle, he defeated a Honor Guard, who gifted Kallus his rifle as a sign of the agent's superior ability in combat. Kallus was surprised by the action but accepted.
